name: Cisco Meraki - Events
description: The Cisco Meraki - Events dashboard provides insights of MR access points, MX security appliances, and MS switches. Panels display information on the number of events, event types, Air Marshall events, connectivity, client DHCP events, and graphs of events over time.
title: Cisco Meraki - Events

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Metricsdatasource}}  airmarshal_events type (rogue_ssid_detected or ssid_spoofing_detected or containing_device or device_alerting)
|	parse regex " (?<name>\S*?)\s(?<msg_type>urls|flows|events|ids-alerts|security_event|airmarshal_events?)\s+" nodrop
| kv regex "=(.*?)(?:\s|$)" "type" nodrop
| kv regex "=\'(.*?)(?:\')" "ssid", "bssid", "src", "dst", "wired_mac", "vlan_id", "channel", "rssi", "fc_type", "fc_subtype", "vap" as ssid, bssid, src_ip, dest_ip, wired_mac, vlan_id, channel, rssi, fc_type, fc_subtype, vap nodrop
| where msg_type matches "airmarshal_events" and type in ("rogue_ssid_detected", "ssid_spoofing_detected", "containing_device", "device_alerting")
| where if ("{{bssid}}" = "*", true, bssid matches "{{bssid}}") AND if ("{{channel}}" = "*", true, channel matches "{{channel}}") AND if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{msg_type}}" = "*", true, msg_type matches "{{msg_type}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}") AND if ("{{ssid}}" = "*", true, ssid matches "{{ssid}}")
| count as eventCount by type
| compare with timeshift 1d
| sort by eventCount, eventCount_1d, type asc

_sourceCategory={{Metricsdatasource}}  events type (vpn_connectivity_change or vpn_registry_change)
|	parse regex " (?<name>\S*?)\s(?<msg_type>urls|flows|events|ids-alerts|security_event|airmarshal_events?)\s+" nodrop
| kv regex "=(.*?)(?:\s|$)" "type" nodrop
| kv regex "=\'(.*?)(?:\')" "vpn_type", "connectivity", "peer_contact", "peer_ident" as vpn_type, connectivity, peer_contact, peer_iden nodrop
| where msg_type="events" and type in ("vpn_connectivity_change", "vpn_registry_change")
|where if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{msg_type}}" = "*", true, msg_type matches "{{msg_type}}")  AND if ("{{vpn_type}}" = "*", true, vpn_type matches "{{vpn_type}}") AND if ("{{connectivity}}" = "*", true, connectivity matches "{{connectivity}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}")
| count as eventCount

_sourceCategory={{Metricsdatasource}}  events "dhcp lease of"
|	parse regex " (?<name>\S*?)\s(?<msg_type>urls|flows|events|ids-alerts|security_event|airmarshal_events?)\s+" nodrop
| parse "events * of ip * from server mac * for client mac * from router * on subnet * with dns *" as type, client_ip, dhcp_server, client_mac, router, subnet, dns nodrop
| where msg_type="events" and _raw matches "* dhcp lease *" and type="dhcp lease"
| where if ("{{client_mac}}" = "*", true, client_mac matches "{{client_mac}}") AND if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{msg_type}}" = "*", true, msg_type matches "{{msg_type}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}") AND if ("{{client_ip}}" = "*", true, client_ip matches "{{client_ip}}")
| count as eventCount

_sourceCategory={{Metricsdatasource}}  events ("vpn_connectivity_change" or "Cellular connection down" or "failover to " or "failover to cellular" or "Cellular connection up" or "dhcp lease of")
|	parse regex " (?<name>\S*?)\s(?<msg_type>urls|flows|events|ids-alerts|security_event|airmarshal_events?)\s+" nodrop
| kv regex "=(.*?)(?:\s|$)" "type" nodrop
| kv regex "=\'(.*?)(?:\')" "vpn_type", "connectivity", "peer_contact", "peer_ident" as vpn_type, connectivity, peer_contact, peer_iden nodrop
| parse "events failover to *" as target nodrop
| parse "Cellular connection *" as connection_status nodrop
| parse "events * of ip * from server mac * for client mac * from router * on subnet * with dns *" as type, client_ip, dhcp_server, client_mac, router, subnet, dns nodrop
| where msg_type="events" and (type in ("vpn_connectivity_change") or (_raw matches "* Cellular connection down*" or _raw matches "* failover to *" or _raw matches "* failover to cellular*" or _raw matches "* Cellular connection up*") or (_raw matches "* dhcp lease *" and type="dhcp lease"))
| timeslice 1h
| where if ("{{client_mac}}" = "*", true, client_mac matches "{{client_mac}}") AND if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{msg_type}}" = "*", true, msg_type matches "{{msg_type}}") AND if ("{{connection_status}}" = "*", true, connection_status matches "{{connection_status}}") AND if ("{{vpn_type}}" = "*", true, vpn_type matches "{{vpn_type}}") AND if ("{{connectivity}}" = "*", true, connectivity matches "{{connectivity}}") AND if ("{{name}}" = "*", true, name matches "{{name}}") AND if ("{{type}}" = "*", true, type matches "{{type}}") AND if ("{{client_ip}}" = "*", true, client_ip matches "{{client_ip}}")
| count as eventCount by _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice(1h)
